verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents concurrency limits, simultaneous-call capacity, or self-serve scaling of call volume. Dialing windows, retry behavior and the llms.txt marketing line about 'millions of calls' are adjacent controls or general positioning, not documented concurrency limits or elastic scaling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging
